source.title: 2026 NFL fantasy football: Six late-round sleepers to target
source.author: Matt Okada
source.summary: Identifies six mostly double-digit-round targets using role, efficiency, and ESPN ADP.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Diggs' 2025 efficiency and new role as Washington's 1B make him a potential inexpensive WR2.
takeaways.rationale: Diggs' 2025 efficiency and new role as Washington's 1B make him a potential inexpensive WR2.
risks: Age and target competition with Terry McLaurin.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Rodriguez has strong tackle-breaking metrics, comparable camp reps, and a plausible red-zone advantage over Bhayshul Tuten.
takeaways.rationale: Rodriguez has strong tackle-breaking metrics, comparable camp reps, and a plausible red-zone advantage over Bhayshul Tuten.
risks: Jacksonville may still favor Tuten or use a committee.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Kincaid is a late tight-end target with a path to a larger Buffalo receiving role.
takeaways.rationale: Kincaid is a late tight-end target with a path to a larger Buffalo receiving role.
risks: He has yet to consistently convert opportunity into elite production.
